cmd: tail -3 /app/input.csv && echo "---" && tail -3 /app/expected.csv && awk -F',' 'NF!=3' /app/input.csv | head -5 && awk -F';' 'NF!=4' /app/expected.csv | head -5 && echo "NF check done" && grep -c 'OK' /app/expected.csv

awk -F',' '{f1=$1;f2=$2;f3=$3; gsub(/^[ \t]+/,"",f1);gsub(/[ \t]+$/,"",f1);gsub(/^[ \t]+/,"",f2);gsub(/[ \t]+$/,"",f2);gsub(/^[ \t]+/,"",f3);gsub(/[ \t]+$/,"",f3); printf "%s;%s;%s;OK\n", toupper(f3),toupper(f2),toupper(f1)}' /app/input.csv | cmp - /app/expected.csv && echo "TRANSFORM HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED"

grep -c $'\r' /app/input.csv; awk -F',' '{for(i=1;i<=3;i++) if($i !~ /^[ \t]*[A-Za-z0-9]+[ \t]*$/) print NR": "$0}' /app/input.csv | head; echo "field check done"; grep -n 'OK' /app/input.csv | head -3; echo "ok check done"; vim --version | head -2
grep -c $'\r' /app/input.csv || echo "no CR characters"; tail -c 50 /app/input.csv | od -c | tail -3

vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'call setreg("t", ":s/^\\s*//e\r")' -c 'call setreg("u", ":s/\s*//e\r")' -c 'redir! > /tmp/regs.txt' -c 'call writefile([getreg("t"), getreg("u")], "/tmp/regs.txt")' -c 'qa!' ; od -c /tmp/regs.txt

cd /app && vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'call setreg("t", ":s/^\\s*//e\r")' -c 'call setreg("u", ":s/\s*//e\r")' -c 'call writefile([getreg("t"), getreg("u")], ".regs_test.txt")' -c 'qa!' ; od -c .regs_test.txt; rm -f .regs_test.txt

cd /app && cat > apply_macros.vim << 'EOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/^\\s*//e|s/\\s*$//e\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\s*,\\s*/;/ge\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/^\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)$/\\U\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/ge\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
EOF
cat apply_macros.vim

cd /app && head -1000 input.csv > .sample.csv && vim -Nu NONE -n -Es .sample.csv -S apply_macros.vim; echo "EXIT=$?"; head -5 .sample.csv; head -1000 expected.csv | cmp - .sample.csv && echo "SAMPLE MATCHES"
cd /app && vim -Nu NONE -n -Es .sample.csv -S apply_macros.vim; echo "EXIT2=$?"; head -1000 expected.csv | cmp - .sample.csv && echo "IDEMPOTENT OK"; rm -f .sample.csv
cd /app && cp input.csv .input_backup.csv && time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "EXIT=$?"
cd /app && cmp input.csv expected.csv && echo "BYTE-FOR-BYTE MATCH" && md5sum input.csv expected.csv

cd /app && vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -S apply_macros.vim -c 'call writefile([string(len(getreg("a")))." ".getreg("a"), string(len(getreg("b")))." ".getreg("b"), string(len(getreg("c")))." ".getreg("c")], ".reglen.txt")' -c 'qa!' ; cat .reglen.txt; rm -f .reglen.txt
cd /app && rm -f .input_backup.csv && ls -la /app/ && echo "---" && cat -A apply_macros.vim
cd /app && time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "EXIT=$?"; cmp /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv && echo "FINAL: BYTE-FOR-BYTE MATCH"
